outOfScopeFindings.what: A Job with backend none fails at start on dev with a job-repo clone refusal
outOfScopeFindings.evidence: Job 31dec365-... (MCP workspace='none', root, pinned lane): admitted with backend none and no pod; 9 s later failed with 'Failed to clone job workspace repo 'job-31dec365' - refusing to fall back to a disconnected git init ...' (src/agent/core/workspace.py). The same refusal was seen on 2026-08-24 when a clone URL lacked credentials (tests/protected_cloud_e2e_results_2026-08-24-e853.md). Only three root none Jobs exist on dev; the previous one (2026-07-27) completed. A3 only sends workspace: null, which the REST path has accepted since A1, so this is a runtime defect on the lite backend, not A3. The agent log was lost with the recycled pinned pod; reproduce on a stack where the agent pod is kept.

outOfScopeFindings.what: A Job that created a VM can't be deleted: DELETE /api/jobs/{id} answers 500 on the vm_creation_retries foreign key
outOfScopeFindings.evidence: D4 Job 414958b8-...: cancelled, VM/VMI/DV/PVC gone, nine DELETEs over ten minutes all 500 'violates foreign key constraint vm_creation_retries_job_id_fkey'. Migration 0257 declares job_id REFERENCES jobs(id) without ON DELETE; no code deletes vm_creation_retries rows for Jobs; 14 terminal dev Jobs carry such rows. The Job's context.vm.status also stays retiring_process_zero after the physical teardown (the 2026-09-28 note stateless_vm_cancel_checkpoint_prune_cleanup_cycle calls that stale status harmless). A 500 rather than a refusal suggests the route never expected the row. Not A3; not filed as an issue.
